en: The image depicts an old postcard showing a two-story building with a distinctive wooden porch and a small spire. The building is surrounded by dense foliage and a wooden fence. The architectural style is typical of Central European rural constructions from the late 19th to early 20th century. The text on the postcard is written in German and printed in red ink. The card has a vintage, sepia-toned aesthetic.
